test_call_1_clean.mp3.label: Test 1 – Clean Call (No Errors)
test_call_1_clean.mp3.flag_reason: No policy violations. This is the baseline golden call.

test_call_2_hallucinated_refund.mp3.label: Test 2 – Agent Hallucinates Policy-Violating Refund
test_call_2_hallucinated_refund.mp3.flag_reason: Turn 6: Agent incorrectly tells a customer who activated 45 days ago that they are eligible for a full refund. FastNet policy POL-001 only allows full refunds within 30 days of activation. The claim is false and a direct policy hallucination.

test_call_3_wrong_callback.mp3.label: Test 3 – Agent Promises 30-Minute Callback (Policy Says 2 Hours)
test_call_3_wrong_callback.mp3.flag_reason: Turn 4: Agent promises a callback 'within thirty minutes'. FastNet policy POL-003 guarantees callbacks within 2 hours during business hours. Promising 30 minutes is an unauthorised commitment the team cannot reliably fulfil.

test_call_4_low_confidence.mp3.label: Test 4 – Low-Confidence Language (I think / Probably)
test_call_4_low_confidence.mp3.flag_reason: Turns 2, 4, 6, 8: Every Agent turn contains repeated hedging language — 'I think', 'probably', 'I'm not sure', 'I believe', 'maybe'. Agents must state FastNet policy confidently. Chronic uncertainty language erodes customer trust and signals the agent is unreliable.

test_call_5_hinglish.mp3.label: Test 5 – Code-Mixed Hindi-English (Hinglish) Customer
test_call_5_hinglish.mp3.flag_reason: Turns 5 and 7: The customer switches to Hinglish to ask about the senior citizen discount (POL-005). The agent completely ignores the question in both turns, responding with off-topic pleasantries. A robust agent must detect and address the discount query regardless of language mixing.

test_call_6_topic_drift.mp3.label: Test 6 – Polite But Topic Drift (Agent Misses Main Question)
test_call_6_topic_drift.mp3.flag_reason: Turns 4 and 6: The customer is explicitly asking whether relocating outside FastNet coverage waives the two-hundred-and-fifty dollar ETF (POL-002). The agent gives polished, sympathetic replies about cancellation in general but never directly confirms or denies the waiver condition. Turn 8 is a deflection — the agent transfers rather than answering a direct yes/no question.
